text:
Alex: quick check / post-launch micro-wave decisions. do we pack the small accessibility fixes into Friday's emergency patch or schedule them for next mini-wave?
Nina: a11y fixes = keyboard focus order + contrast tweak. dev estimate ~1.5 days total. QE window for hotpatch is 24hrs only.
Ravi: we also have a critical customer bug (session reset) marked p0; that one is definite for the patch. anything else needs to be weighed against QE time.
Sam: can we split work? ship focus order in hotpatch, defer contrast tweak. focus change has tests with low regression risk.
Alex: proposal accepted: hotpatch includes p0 session fix + focus-order fix. contrast tweak deferred. owners: Ravi -> session fix PR, Nina -> focus PR behind flag if needed, Sam -> QE plan, Alex -> release note + CS blurb.
ops-bot: canary scheduled: v1.0.7-hotfix -> Fri 07:00 UTC to "canary-small". Checks: smoke, accessibility-checks, error-rate.
Sam: QE: 5 smoke cases + 2 a11y regressions. rollback if error-rate > 0.4% or p50 latency regresses > 20ms.
Nina: will prep contrast tweak spec for mini-wave and include visual QA steps.
Ravi: landing PR by Thu EOD, need 30m review.
Alex: pre-canary huddle Fri 06:30 UTC. ping me for blockers.
All: ack.
